description: This file defines API routes for managing patient records in a healthcare backend system using FastAPI and MongoDB. It includes CRUD operations with role-based access control, data mapping functions, and external dependencies.

methods.name: Patient _patient_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB document into a Patient model.

methods.name: None _assert_patient_owner_or_admin( patient_doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Checks if the user has permission to act on a patient's data, raising an HTTP 403 error if not.

methods.name: List[Patient] list_patients(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"])))
methods.description: Lists all patient profiles; accessible only to roles 'admin' and 'doctor'.

methods.name: Patient create_patient( payload: PatientCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Creates a new patient profile; allows patients to create their own and admins to create profiles for any user.

methods.name: Patient get_patient( patient_id: str = Path(..., description="Patient document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific patient profile by id, with RBAC enforcement for access.

methods.name: Patient update_patient( patient_id: str, payload: PatientUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates an existing patient profile, with RBAC checks to ensure proper permissions.

methods.name: None delete_patient( patient_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a patient profile; restricted to admin role.

ctags.name: _assert_patient_owner_or_admin
ctags.signature: ( patient_doc: Dict[str, Any], user_claims: Dict[str, Any] )

ctags.name: create_patient
ctags.signature: ( payload: PatientCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: get_patient
ctags.signature: ( patient_id: str = Path(..., description="Patient document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )

ctags.name: list_patients
ctags.pattern: /^async def list_patients(_: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"]))) -> List/

ctags.signature: ( patient_id: str, payload: PatientUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
